portability.uploading: Uploading and validating {size}… The server checks the whole archive before changing anything.
portability.cancelled: Upload cancelled. Your file and options are kept; nothing was imported.
portability.retryHint: Nothing was changed. Your file and options are kept, so you can retry.
portability.skippedMedia: {count} media file(s) could not be included.
portability.alreadyRestored: This backup was already restored; nothing was changed.

problems.extension: Choose a .tar.gz archive exported by PandaWords.
problems.tooLarge: This archive is larger than the {max} upload limit.

progress.label: Learning progress
progress.autoHint: Progress is imported only when the server verifies the archive was exported by your own account; otherwise words start as new cards.
progress.onHint: Import review cards and review history. Memory you already have for a sense is kept and never overwritten.
progress.offHint: Import words only. Every word becomes a new card with no review history.

summary.sameSource: The archive was exported by your account.
summary.otherSource: The archive comes from another account or server.

project.importHint: Import a .pandawords-project.tar.gz archive. It always creates a new project copy; shared dictionary entries are merged and never overwritten.

user.backupHint: Download all of your projects, words, notes, media, learning progress and preferences. Your password and account settings are never included.
user.importHint: Restore a .pandawords-user.tar.gz backup into this account. Data is merged: projects are added as copies, and existing memory, overrides and changed preferences are kept.
user.confirm: Restore {name} into your account? Projects are added as new copies (restoring a different backup over existing data creates duplicates), and words whose spelling belongs to another account cause a conflict. Existing memory, overrides and preferences you changed are kept. This cannot be undone automatically.

errors.too_large: The archive exceeds the server upload limit.
errors.malformed_archive: This file is not a valid PandaWords archive.
errors.missing_manifest: This archive has no PandaWords manifest.
errors.unexpected_format: This archive is a different kind of PandaWords export (project vs. full backup).
errors.unsupported_version: This archive comes from an unsupported PandaWords version.
errors.unsupported_schema: This archive uses an unsupported data version.
errors.integrity: The archive failed its integrity check; it may be damaged or modified.
errors.identity_conflict: The archive conflicts with data that belongs to another account.
errors.unsafe_entry: The archive contains unsafe entries and was rejected.
errors.invalid_media: A media file in the archive is invalid.
errors.apply_failed: The import could not be saved. Nothing was changed; please retry.
errors.rejected: The archive was rejected and nothing was imported. Check the details below.
errors.export_too_large: Your data exceeds the backup size limits. Please contact an administrator.

siteBackup.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete {count} selected backup archive(s)? This cannot be undone. Site data is not changed.
siteBackup.deleteFailed: {error} {count} archive(s) remain selected. Confirm to retry deletion, or cancel.
siteBackup.importSteps: To restore a local site archive, transfer it to the server. From the deployment directory containing compose.yml and .env, run the command below with its server path. This dialog does not upload or restore files.
siteBackup.restoreSteps: Download the selected archive, then transfer it to the server. From the deployment directory containing compose.yml and .env, run the command below with its server path. Restore replaces the whole site's database and media and temporarily stops services.
siteBackup.hint: Create an on-demand backup of the whole site database and media.
siteBackup.running: A backup is running. This page refreshes its status automatically.
siteBackup.restoreNotice: Site restore is not available in the browser. Operators restore with deploy/restore.sh on the server.
